note: A retired oncology pharmaceutical sales representative - a credible professional career, so successful is a fair match on occupation. Everything else fails. On income he chose the $1,000 product specifically to preserve cash he needs for 'other things that are popping up', which is the opposite of price being a quality signal. On starting point he is not going from good to great: he is 68, a complete beginner who had never heard of mobility work, carrying 'a lot of injuries that are lingering', and the single beginner workout he attempted left his knees hurting badly and his back tweaked. That also fails the exclusion criterion in spirit - the stated ICP excludes people whose bodies cannot take the programme, even though it words the exclusion in terms of being overweight and gym-averse rather than clinically limited. Judged on the criteria as written and not on the fact that he paid. He is the second closed deal in this batch to sit outside the stated ICP, and the observation already recorded in icp.json - that the stated ICP has no clinical criterion at all - applies here more sharply than in any prior case.
